notes.title: The Achievement System for "Dreamlike love with Seira" is now available
notes.content:
What makes "Dreamlike love with Seira" stand out as particularly delicious during its first sale at a 10% discount?

It's the launch of the achievement system!

There are a total of five achievements for "Dreamlike love with Seira" which can be unlocked by meeting certain conditions as you progress through the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138797/b2f396640d66d95630c6d5f45250ff23396104ee.jpg[/img]

Please update the game to the latest version on Steam and replay to unlock the achievements!

notes.title: "Dreamlike Love with Seira" Steam Community Items are now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138797/06de55af4687d61496ca50efaaa866832430389a.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 
The "Dreamlike Love with Seira" Steam Community Items have finally passed various approvals and are now available!!

(Achievement cannot be implemented due to engine limitations, unfortunately)

The "Dreamlike Love with Seira" Steam Community Items include:

- 5 levels of badges + 1 Foil badge
- 7 Trading Cards
- 5 Profile Background
- 5 emoticons

Thank you all for your support and patience!
